# Xarelto

Xarelto is a direct oral anticoagulant (DOAC) named once in the corpus. It is mentioned alongside three other anticoagulant products — Eliquis, Pradaxa, and Lixiana — as part of the informational brochures recommended for use in structured patient education about atrial fibrillation [^src1].

The mention appears in the context of Indicator 8 (Structured Patient Education) within the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), which documents how Danish healthcare regions educate patients about atrial fibrillation, anticoagulation therapy, and the ABC Pathway model of integrated care (covering stroke prevention, symptom control, and cardiovascular risk reduction). Xarelto's product brochure is one of several materials — alongside regional pamphlets on anticoagulation (AK) treatment — recommended for use in this patient education effort [^src1].

No further details, relationships, claims, or timeline events involving Xarelto are available in the corpus.
